Package domain

Class AnonymousUser

java.lang.Object
domain.User
domain.AnonymousUser
public class AnonymousUser extends User
Author:
Joel Forcadell (joel.forcadell@estudiantat.upc.edu) Represents an anonymous user in the system.

Unlike a RegisteredUser, an AnonymousUser only stores the user identifier inherited from the User class. This class is useful for cases where a user interacts with the system without providing registration details such as username, password, or email.
